_about: What the original plays between going into a level's door and its medal: the delay a
level may set for it, and the three cutscenes that fill that delay - 4-01's rocket launch,
4-19's landing and 2-32's dragon knight (the program's P2; planning step 123). Read by
sim/Cutscene and played by the layer. Every number is DECODED from the original's script
arguments pushed last-first, 00_order 8.0) and checked against footage F17 where F17 shows
it (out/parity/footage/F17.md). All of it runs after the win: nothing here reaches
Game::Level's play, only the time before the medal and the pictures behind it.
Each cutscene is played where its level places its entity - rocket_launch, rocket_landing,
dragon_knight_spawn, end_delay - and never by the level's name.

_source: DECODED: GameStateController::GameStateController (bytes 121296..122160) #24-29 writes 1400
to gameLostDelay and copies it into gameWonDelay (ui.json level_end.beats); #143-175 then
SeekEntity('end_delay') and, where it is found, gameWonDelay = its GetUInt('time'). The lost
screen's delay is never overridden. checkGameEnd (bytes 125613..126638) #209-229 raises
levelFinishedLayer once gameEndElapsedTime passes it.
CENSUS (the converted levels' metadata/time, the converter's custom data): 3 of the 128
levels place one - level0c (4-01) 5000, level18c (4-19) 14500, level31a (2-32) 6600 - and
each is the level of one cutscene below.
MEASURED: F17 r1 puts 4-01's finish 5.10 s after the entry frame and F17 r5 puts 4-19's
14.65 s after it; the emulator's clock runs 1.0-1.5 % long (ui.json level_end.beats), and
the decode is taken.
DECODED: ETHCallback_rocket_launch (bytes 462571..464080), 4-01's `rocket_launch` (level0c.esc
id 2057, static="1"; INFERRED, not decoded: a static entity's callback runs after the game
state in the frame, so it starts on the frame the door is reached). #1-3 only once isGameWon. #5-29
SeekEntity('door.ent') and SeekEntity('rocket_bridge'). #31 LAUNCH_TIME 7600. #33-44 its first
frame is the one the door carries no endElapsedTime yet: #46-70 eqCounter and
endElapsedTime 0; #72-120 the door's start, and destiny = start + scale(vector2(0, -390))
(#87-93, -390 pushed first: the y); #122-170 the bridge's the same with
scale(vector2(-32, 0)) (#137-143); #172-174 playRocketMusic. Then EVERY frame, the first too:
#176-206 endElapsedTime and eqCounter += getLastFrameElapsedTime; #220-256 when eqCounter
> 100 (CMPIu, JP) and endElapsedTime < 6000 (CMPIu, TS), eqCounter = 0 and
startEarthquake(3, 0) (earthquake.json rocket_launch); #258-261 only while endElapsedTime <
7600: #263-308 the door at interpolate(start, destiny, smoothBeginning(t / 7600)) and
#310-357 the bridge at interpolate(start, destiny, smoothBeginning(t / 3800)). interpolate
(bytes 314380..314472) has no clamp, so the bridge goes on past -32: -64 at 7600.
MEASURED (F17 r1, 4-01): the rise fits (0, -390) x smoothBeginning(t / 7600) from t0 10.553
125.5, 180.0 and 216.8 - and the bridge the unclamped smoothBeginning(t / 3800) (rms 0.29 u),
-32.4, -40.5 and -48.0 u at #316, #332 and #348. The camera does not follow the rocket up.
DECODED: ETHCallback_rocket_landing (bytes 464080..466030), 4-19's `rocket_landing`
(level18c.esc id 2517, static="1"). #1-3 only once isGameWon. #5-55 SeekEntity('door.ent'),
('dark_mage.ent'), ('eclipse.ent') and ('spiral'). #57 LAUNCH_TIME 12500. Its first frame
(#59-183): endElapsedTime 0; the door's start and destiny = start + scale(vector2(256, 400))
(#100-106, 400 pushed first: the y); startAngle and destinyAngle (angle - 130) stored and

there is one, Scale(0.9) and SetAlpha(clamp(its scale x / getScale(), 0, 1)); #229-256
endElapsedTime += getLastFrameElapsedTime ONLY while it is below 12500 (CMPIu, JNS);
#298-305 bias = smoothBeginning(endElapsedTime / 12500); #307-333 the door's
SetVector3('originalPos', interpolate(start, destiny, bias)) - not its position: on this
zero-g level Game::loop's linearMotion puts the door at originalPos plus its bob
(motions.json door); #335-341 dark_mage.ent (the character) SetPosition(door.GetPosition());
#343-366 destiny = GetCameraPos() + GetScreenSize() x (0.5, 1); #368-385 start = destiny +
(0, eclipse.GetSize().y), GetSize being GetCurrentSize, the frame times the entity's scale
(reference/ethanon ETHSpriteEntity.cpp:652-682): 32 x 2 = 64 units; #387-396 both x's the
eclipse's own; #398-411 eclipse.SetPositionXY(interpolate(start, destiny, smoothEnd(bias)));
#413-429 brightness = max(0, min(interpolate(2, 0.1, smoothEnd(bias)), 1)) - 1 until
smoothEnd(bias) passes 0.526, about 6.9 s in, and 0.1 at 12.5 s; #431-455 the spiral's
SetColor(spiralColor x brightness).
DECODED (engine): the key's Scale(0.9) is ETHEntity::Scale(float), which scales the entity's
particle systems with it (reference/ethanon ETHEntity.cpp:591-599, ETHSpriteEntity.cpp:512-518,
ETHParticleManager.cpp:444-451, ETHParticleSystem.cpp:27-40): key_scale_per_frame shrinks the
key's two sparkles systems too, after the key's own update and before the draw (the key is
dynamic, rocket_landing static: ETHScene.cpp:467-488). Planning step 170.
MEASURED (F17 r5, 4-19): the rocket sinks (+400 u) with smoothBeginning(t / 12.5) from t0
21.874 (rms 2.9 px), upright, drifting right; the spiral dims from about 7.1 s and is flat
from 12.6 s; the eclipse's top rises 169 px to rest at 610 px (rms 1.06 px).
DECODED: ETHCallback_dragon_knight_spawn (bytes 386175..386379), 2-32's
`dragon_knight_spawn` (level31a.esc id 1283, static="1"; INFERRED: it runs on the frame the

#1-3 isFinished - gameFinished, which a DEATH sets as well as the door (isGameWon is
gameFinished && !gameLost; isFinished is gameFinished alone); #5-21

ETHCallback_dragon_knight (bytes 386379..388631), the knight's own, from the next frame
(INFERRED, planning step 123's deviation 3: an added dynamic entity): its first run (#2-142) sets hasStarted 0, elapsedTime 0, dest 0, keeps
SeekEntity('waypoint0') and ('waypoint1')'s positions, makes its FrameTimer and
SetColor(V3_ZERO). Then every run: #165-179 elapsedTime += getLastFrameElapsedTime;
#181-231 while distance(waypoint<dest>, its point) < scale(16): #233-256 currentDest = dest,
dest + 1; #258-339 no SeekEntity('waypoint' + dest) - dest 0, DeleteEntity(itself) and
levelFinishedEffect(its point, its point + scale(16, -16)) (effects.json finish); #340-437
else hasStarted 1, elapsedTime 0, holdTime = waypoint<currentDest>'s GetUInt('hold') and
the new destination. #451-480 it walks only while hasStarted and elapsedTime > holdTime -
so from its spawn it FALLS, undriven, until it first comes within 16 of waypoint0; and
holding it sets nothing at all. Walking: #482-496 moveVec (its x < the destination's ? 1 :
-1, 0); #513-532 speed = scale(1.7) x min(66, frame) / GetCurrentPhysicsTimeStepMS, the
minions' 33.3333 (minions.json patrol): 1.7 px a step, 51 px/s; #534-553
SetLinearVelocity((moveVec.x x speed, its y velocity)); #555-581 SetFrame(timer.set(0, 3,
120, true), dir == 1 ? 1 : 2), dir = findCharacterDirection(getAngle(the velocity BEFORE
this set), true) (decode/D2_check.md): row 1 after a leftward step, else 2.
dragon_knight.ent (the original's entities/): minion.png cut 4 x 4, startFrame 4 (column 0,
